boards.title: Your First Weekend at Kettering College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible Friday-to-Sunday introduction to Kettering College and nearby all-ages places, with current plans confirmed through direct official sources.

cards.title: Start with the student-life calendar
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Kettering College
cards.notes: Check the official Student Life accounts for current programming, then save one appealing campus activity before making weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: Use the college’s own channels to find a timely first connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering College Student Life provides programs and leadership opportunities and directs students to its official college and Student Life social accounts for current involvement information.
cards.access_notes: Program timing and locations vary; consult the official Student Life accounts before going.

cards.title: Learn the library setup
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Campus orientation
cards.notes: Locate the collection and study rooms, test your student login, and note the reservation process before coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: Turn the campus library into a familiar study base.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kettering College Library offers approximately 8,000 books, more than 125 current journal subscriptions, study rooms, and off-campus resource access for current students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Some borrowing and online services require current institutional credentials or identification; confirm weekend building access locally.

cards.title: Choose a Friday community gathering
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Campus Ministries
cards.notes: Read the chaplain’s weekly email for that night’s location, then arrive for the 6:30 p.m. fellowship period if you wish to participate.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Friday option centered on snacks, worship, and fellowship.
cards.evidence_claim: When school is in session, Kettering College’s Collective meets Friday evenings at changing locations, with snacks and fellowship at 6:30 p.m. and worship at 7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Offered Friday evenings only when school is in session; the chaplain’s weekly email supplies the current location.

cards.title: Pick up weekend provisions
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Oakwood
cards.notes: Use the Oakwood store as a practical grocery stop; set a budget beforehand and choose only what you need for the weekend.
cards.short_summary: An evening grocery run before the rest of the weekend unfolds.
cards.evidence_claim: Dorothy Lane Market lists its Oakwood store at 2710 Far Hills Avenue in Dayton and reports daily hours of 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the Oakwood store as open daily from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.; purchases are optional.

cards.title: Consider a Saturday service
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Across from the college area
cards.notes: If worship fits your weekend, choose the contemporary or traditional service and arrive early enough to find the correct room.
cards.short_summary: An optional Saturday gathering connected to the college’s faith setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering Adventist Church advertises Saturday worship with a contemporary service at 10 a.m. and a traditional sanctuary service at 10:15 a.m.; Kettering College invites students to attend services there.
cards.access_notes: The church lists Saturday services at 10 a.m. and 10:15 a.m.; participation is optional and visitors should verify schedule changes.

cards.title: Walk the Adirondack Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Hills & Dales MetroPark
cards.notes: Follow the color-coded Adirondack Trail toward Dogwood Pond, keep dogs leashed, and leave bicycles off the hiking trails.
cards.short_summary: A mapped woodland loop with a pond, waterfall, and historic features.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Rivers MetroParks maps the 1.46-mile Adirondack Trail at Hills & Dales MetroPark and identifies Dogwood Pond, an overlook shelter, benches, a waterfall, and a loop trail.
cards.access_notes: Use designated trails; dogs must be leashed and bicycles are not permitted on trails. Check MetroParks notices before departure.

cards.title: See what is showing at Rosewood
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Rosewood Arts Center
cards.notes: Browse the current gallery exhibition first, then ask staff which workshops or studios welcome newcomers without prerequisites.
cards.short_summary: A city arts center with exhibitions, performances, and specialized studios.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering’s Rosewood Arts Center presents gallery exhibitions, theater performances, classes, artist studios, and special events at 2655 Olson Drive.
cards.access_notes: The center lists Saturday hours of 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Some studios require prior coursework and orientation; classes may require payment.

cards.title: Loop around the Civic Commons
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Lincoln Park Boulevard
cards.notes: Walk the paths around the pond, pause at the civic artworks, and check the city calendar before approaching any event setup.
cards.short_summary: A compact park loop joining water, public art, and community space.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Kettering describes Lincoln Park Civic Commons as a 14-acre park with a pond, civic art, walking paths, benches, bike racks, and event space beside Fraze Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park Civic Commons - Play Kettering
cards.access_notes: The park is publicly described by the city, but event areas may have separate rules or ticketing; check current notices.

cards.title: Reset at the public library
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Wilmington Pike
cards.notes: Bring a reading or planning task, use the free Wi-Fi, and ask staff about study-space availability before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A Saturday-friendly branch with study areas and practical digital tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Dayton Metro Library’s Wilmington-Stroop Branch offers free Wi-Fi, laptop and tablet lending, group-study rooms, event spaces, and a designated teen area.
cards.access_notes: The current branch page lists Saturday hours of 9:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Sunday closure; confirm holiday exceptions.

cards.entity_name: National Museum of the United States Air Force
cards.title: Finish among historic aircraft
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Wright-Patterson AFB area
cards.notes: Allow several hours, follow entrance screening rules, and begin with one gallery era rather than trying to absorb every exhibit.
cards.short_summary: A spacious Sunday finale tracing aviation history through aircraft and artifacts.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Museum of the United States Air Force is open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., offers free admission, and displays more than 350 aerospace vehicles and missiles.
cards.source_title: Hours and Admission | National Museum of the United States Air Force
cards.access_notes: Open 9 a.m.–5 p.m. daily except Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s Day. Entry screening applies; theater and simulators cost extra.
